concerns.text: SC-005 requires detection of at least 5 distinct OWASP Top 10 vulnerability types *present in the ground‑truth dataset*. The specification does not guarantee that the chosen public dataset (Devign or CodeXGLUE) actually contains five such types, making the success criterion potentially unreachable. Add a requirement that the dataset must include ≥5 OWASP Top 10 categories, or re‑phrase SC‑005 to be conditional on the observed presence of those types.
